risk_description: Published 'step-free' claim is wrong on the day (ramp locked, lift out of service) and a wheelchair user is stranded
proposed_control: Field-verify before publish; live status where available; prominent report-a-problem; call-venue fallback with phone number
escalation_trigger: A verified access feature reports 'not working' or confidence decays below threshold
residual_risk: Medium - user has a report + fallback path

risk_description: Stale or unverified access information shown as if current
proposed_control: Three-state status on every field (verified / missing / requires confirmation); confidence decay; last-verified date shown
escalation_trigger: Record not re-verified within decay window

risk_description: Sensory-sensitive attendee encounters unpredictable noise/lighting with no quiet space signposted
proposed_control: Collect and publish quiet-space and lighting/noise notes; predictable route option
escalation_trigger: No quiet space identified for an event with amplified sound

risk_description: Last-mile path (station to door) blocked by roadworks or closed crossing
proposed_control: Link out to TfNSW trip planner; show alternate entrance; advocacy brief to transport operator
escalation_trigger: Path disruption reported or works notice detected
residual_risk: Medium - alternative entrance or advocacy output

risk_description: Safety/access instructions machine-translated incorrectly and mislead a non-English speaker
proposed_control: Human-reviewed access content; machine translation limited to UI strings and clearly labelled; RTL support
escalation_trigger: New safety-critical content added without human review

risk_description: User photos in reports capture bystanders, including minors
proposed_control: Consent flow; face blurring; no location history stored; minimum data collection
escalation_trigger: Photo contains identifiable person without consent

risk_description: AI-suggested attribute or risk is accepted without human review and published as fact
proposed_control: Every AI output labelled 'suggested'; human approval required before publish; append-only history; revert
escalation_trigger: AI suggestion published without an approver recorded

risk_description: Attendance far exceeds the scenario range, overwhelming accessible facilities and staffing
proposed_control: Publish a scenario range not a point estimate; define capacity triggers for extra accessible toilets and staffing
escalation_trigger: Attendance exceeds upper scenario bound by defined margin

risk_description: Coordinated spam or malicious edit misroutes users
proposed_control: Login-gated edits; append-only version history; photo evidence; moderator queue; revert
escalation_trigger: Edit flagged or reverted by moderators above threshold

risk_description: Prototype implies Council endorsement, funding or procurement
proposed_control: Explicit 'not Council-endorsed' disclaimer; council boundary statement (partner/facilitate/advocate); no Council branding without permission
escalation_trigger: Any public communication without the disclaimer
